findings.note: Philips is the presenter of H.861, a town petition (local approval received) that would let the town of Sharon grant local voting rights to permanent resident non-citizens. It was referred to the Election Laws committee on 2025-02-27, heard on 2025-05-06, and on 2026-03-19 was attached to study order H5253. Related to the non-citizen voting theme, not to ID or proof of citizenship.
subjects: local voting rights for permanent residents
